description.value: Britannia Brewing Company is a craft microbrewery and full-service bar-restaurant in the heart of historic Steveston Village, drawing its identity from the area's fishing and shipyard heritage. Established in 2014, it brews its own ales on site and serves a locally-sourced menu heavy on BC seafood, grass-fed beef, and house-made staples. Steveston is one of the Lower Mainland's most popular cycling destinations, placing this waterfront pub at a natural junction for touring cyclists finishing a loop around Richmond's dyke trails.
